name: valid-validate-element
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/dtd.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
try
XMLValidate r
end try
try
XMLValidate (XMLChild r index 1)
end try
XMLClose d

name: valid-schema-missing
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/external-dtd.xml")
try
XMLSchema d with respect to (POSIX file "$FILES/nope.xsd")
end try
XMLError
XMLClose d

name: valid-validname
script:
try
XMLValidName "abc"
end try
try
XMLValidName "a:b"
end try
try
XMLValidName "1abc"
end try
try
XMLValidName "_x-1.y"
end try
try
XMLValidName ""
end try
try
XMLValidName "a b"
end try
try
XMLValidName "é"
end try
try
XMLValidName {"a", "1", "a:b"}
end try
try
XMLValidName {}
end try
try
XMLValidName 12
end try

name: valid-error-after-success
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/no-dtd.xml")
try
XMLValidate d
end try
try
XMLSchema d with respect to (POSIX file "$FILES/people.xsd")
end try
set e to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/external-dtd.xml")
try
XMLValidate e
end try
XMLError
try
XMLSchema d with respect to (POSIX file "$FILES/people.xsd")
end try
try
XMLRelaxNG e with respect to (POSIX file "$FILES/people.rng")
end try
XMLError
XMLClose e
XMLClose d
